scenes.title: Hook
scenes.card: The timber look. Without the weight.
scenes.vo: Want the look of old timber beams, without the weight?

scenes.title: Real up close
scenes.vo: Meet Heritage Timber, by Ekena Millwork. | Each beam is cast from real, weathered timber, so it looks solid, even up close.

scenes.title: The weight
scenes.vo: A five-and-a-half-inch beam, twelve feet long, ships at about eighteen pounds. | One person can lift it.

scenes.title: One-person install
scenes.card: One-person install. Slides over a block.
scenes.vo: It slides over a wood block, with standard household tools. | And it's hollow, so it can hide wiring.

scenes.title: Why not solid wood?
scenes.vo: And unlike solid wood, it resists warping and cracking, with less upkeep.

scenes.title: Finish and size
scenes.vo: Pick from six hand-stained finishes, or primed. | Eight cross-section sizes, in lengths from four to twenty-four feet.

scenes.title: Quick Ship
scenes.vo: It's in stock, and usually ships in three to five business days.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.vo: Order a sample, and see it in your own light.
